name: PBQtah Winter 2022
information: * This is a "Please Be Quiet" competition, so standard speedsolving events will not be held. * Each competitor is only allowed to bring one guest with them to the competition. * Please review the [COVID Precautions tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PBQtahWinter2022#17172-covid-precautions) before registering. * It is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot. * No outside food and drink is allowed in the venue.
